name: Daily Brief
tagline: Calendar, inbox, and Slack ranked into one morning brief.
description: Grok Bot profile from awesome-grokbot. Reads today's calendar, overnight mail, and Slack mentions, then ranks what matters. Does not dump every unread thread. Connects Google Calendar, Gmail, and Slack.

install.command: Paste this SETUP.md URL as the first message in a new Grok Bot chat.
